versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the user-guide for Free Model Router (FMR), covering installation, upgrade, migration from Skill mode, OpenAI/Anthropic agent harness integration, channel registration & API key setup, model/channel switching, troubleshooting, data security, and capability discovery.
- Introduces a structured probe-based workflow and strict evidence-based global rules for state detection and all write operations.
- Provides precise status determination logic (including handling of multi-user/cross-location scenarios and version mismatches) and clear routing of user intents to relevant chapters.
- Outlines dynamic capability and provider discovery, ensuring all outputs reflect the installed FMR version's real-time features.
- Details strong separation of agent and user roles, especially around key registration and manual steps.
- Supports dynamic updates, downgrade detection, and safe configuration management, referencing chapter/data tables as needed.
